{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of year-over-year changes in R&D expenses over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expense growth may face greater uncertainty and risk, leading to higher required returns. This volatility can signal potential future disruptions or innovations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Acceleration", "construction": "difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of total employees, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating employee growth may be experiencing increasing returns to scale or improving operational efficiency, leading to higher future returns. This acceleration can signal strong future growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "number of unique suppliers reported in the firm's 10-K filings over the past year, manually collected from EDGAR", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may face greater operational risks and challenges, leading to higher required returns. This complexity can signal potential future disruptions or bottlenecks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Citation Network Centrality", "construction": "eigenvector centrality of the firm's patents in the USPTO patent citation network over the past 5 years, using patent data from the USPTO", "rationale": "Firms with highly central patents in the citation network may have more influential and valuable innovations, leading to higher future returns. This centrality can signal strong future growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Busyness", "construction": "average number of other public company board seats held by the firm's board members, using data from proxy statements and EDGAR", "rationale": "Firms with busy board members may face greater agency costs and monitoring challenges, leading to higher required returns. This busyness can signal potential future governance issues.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Investor Concentration", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of institutional investor ownership, using 13F filings from the SEC", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated institutional ownership may face greater pressure to meet short-term expectations, leading to higher required returns. This concentration can signal potential future agency conflicts.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "percentage of total revenue earned from the firm's top 5 customers, using Compustat data and 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with highly concentrated customer bases may face greater revenue risks and challenges, leading to higher required returns. This concentration can signal potential future disruptions or losses.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Dispersion", "construction": "number of unique geographic segments reported in the firm's 10-K filings over the past year, manually collected from EDGAR", "rationale": "Firms with highly dispersed geographic operations may face greater operational risks and challenges, leading to higher required returns. This dispersion can signal potential future disruptions or bottlenecks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Line Complexity", "construction": "number of unique product lines reported in the firm's 10-K filings over the past year, manually collected from EDGAR", "rationale": "Firms with complex product lines may face greater operational risks and challenges, leading to higher required returns. This complexity can signal potential future disruptions or bottlenecks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Venture Capital Investment", "construction": "total corporate venture capital investments made by the firm over the past 5 years, using data from Venture Economics and 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with active corporate venture capital programs may be experiencing increasing returns to innovation and entrepreneurship, leading to higher future returns. This investment can signal strong future growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
